[[File:Coronet_cargo_manifest.png|thumb|right|200px|Cargo manifest for the ''Coronet'']]
{{Quote|You're in charge of the cargo manifest, right?''"<br />"''Uh, yes. I have it right here.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the ''Coronet''{{'s}} protocol droid|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
'''Cargo manifests''' (also known as '''ship manifests''') listed all the particulars of the goods loaded on a vessel, for official and administrative purposes. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] stationed in the cargo bay of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] maintained the vessel's cargo manifest, one which had been fraudulently altered by rogue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]]. The manifest that accompanied [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal effects from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] stated that all four statues of [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|the Sages of Dwartii]] were solid [[Neuranium/Legends|neuranium]], even though [[Sistros/Legends|one of them]] had been hollowed in the center to store [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|Palpatine's lightsaber]].
